q: When an object is placed in a liquid of a lower density, the object ____.
e: When an object is placed in a liquid of a lower density, the object sinks. Density compares mass with the space that mass occupies.

q: If it is placed in a liquid of a greater density, it ____.
e: If it is placed in a liquid of a greater density, it floats. Density compares mass with the space that mass occupies.

q: Since the amount of submerged portion for a floating body is inversely proportional to the specific gravity of the liquid, the more submerged, the ____ the specific gravity.
e: Since the amount of submerged portion for a floating body is inversely proportional to the specific gravity of the liquid, the more submerged, the less the specific gravity. The physics in this sentence is built around less.

q: The hydrometer is an instrument for measuring the density (or) ____ of liquids.
e: The hydrometer is an instrument for measuring the density (or) relative density of liquids. Relative density here means mass per unit volume. Density compares mass with the space that mass occupies.

q: It usually consists of a glass tube with a long ____ at one end.
e: It usually consists of a glass tube with a long bulb at one end. The physics in this sentence is built around bulb.

q: The bulb is weighted with ____ so that the device floats vertically in the liquid.
e: The bulb is weighted with lead shot so that the device floats vertically in the liquid. The physics in this sentence is built around lead shot.

q: If the hydrometer floats higher, it indicates that the liquid has a ____ density.
e: If the hydrometer floats higher, it indicates that the liquid has a higher density. Density compares mass with the space that mass occupies.

q: The hydrometer sinks in the liquid until the weight of the liquid displaced is equal to the weight of the ____.
e: The hydrometer sinks in the liquid until the weight of the liquid displaced is equal to the weight of the hydrometer. Weight is mg, a force toward Earth's centre, not the same as mass.

q: The hydrometer is calibrated to measure the density of the liquid in ____.
e: The hydrometer is calibrated to measure the density of the liquid in $\text{kg m}^{-3}$. Density compares mass with the space that mass occupies.

q: Special hydrometers are used to test the specific gravity of solutions in ____ in order to determine the condition of the battery.
e: Special hydrometers are used to test the specific gravity of solutions in storage batteries in order to determine the condition of the battery. The physics in this sentence is built around storage batteries.

q: The relative density of the acid in a fully charged car battery is ____.
e: The relative density of the acid in a fully charged car battery is 1.25. Density compares mass with the space that mass occupies.

q: Milk and wine can be tested to make sure they have not been diluted with ____.
e: Milk and wine can be tested to make sure they have not been diluted with water. The physics in this sentence is built around water.

q: Hydrometer is a test tube like cylinder with overall density less than one (or) less than the density of ____.
e: Hydrometer is a test tube like cylinder with overall density less than one (or) less than the density of water. Density compares mass with the space that mass occupies.

q: Weight of hydrometer = Weight of water displaced = (volume of water displaced × density of water) × ____.
e: Weight of hydrometer = Weight of water displaced = (volume of water displaced × density of water) × g. Density compares mass with the space that mass occupies. Weight is mg, a force toward Earth's centre, not the same as mass.

q: An alloy is made by mixing 360 g of copper, of density $9 \text{ g cm}^{-3}$, with 80 g of ____, of density $8 \text{ g cm}^{-3}$.
e: An alloy is made by mixing 360 g of copper, of density $9 \text{ g cm}^{-3}$, with 80 g of iron, of density $8 \text{ g cm}^{-3}$. Iron here means the metal in magnetite and the common magnetic element. Density compares mass with the space that mass occupies.

q: One litre of milk (density ____ $\text{g cm}^{-3}$) is mixed with 0.5 litre of water (density $1 \text{ g cm}^{-3}$).
e: One litre of milk (density 1.2 $\text{g cm}^{-3}$) is mixed with 0.5 litre of water (density $1 \text{ g cm}^{-3}$). Density compares mass with the space that mass occupies.

q: Mini-submarine has the total volume of ____ $\text{m}^3$. Its mass is 2000 kg.
e: Mini-submarine has the total volume of 24 $\text{m}^3$. Its mass is 2000 kg. The physics in this sentence is built around 24.

q: Normal atmospheric pressure 1 atm is equal to ____ Pa.
e: Normal atmospheric pressure 1 atm is equal to $1.013 \times 10^5$ Pa. The same force on a smaller area means a larger pressure.
